notes: two taḥwīl branches; the first stops at «أبان» and the second repeats its names; the tail after «قتادة» is written once and is shared by both
«- قال زيد -» and «- وقال مسلم -» set off two wordings of the matn (Zayd's and Muslim's): wording variants, left out; the chain «عن ابن عباس» is the same in both
the Prophet's words end the chain at the Companion Ibn Abbas
